question.text: Let $|\mathrm{A}|=6$, where A is a $3 \times 3$ matrix. If $\left|\operatorname{adj}\left(3 \operatorname{adj}\left(\mathrm{~A}^{2} \cdot \operatorname{adj}(2 \mathrm{~A})\right)\right)\right|=2^{\mathrm{m}} \cdot 3^{\mathrm{n}}, \mathrm{m}, \mathrm{n} \in \mathbf{N}$, then $\mathrm{m}+\mathrm{n}$ is equal to $\_\_\_\_$.
